risk: Sales slower than plan; buyers delay purchases while waiting for the proposed 2027 duty/VAT exemption on panels and batteries
mitigation: Target SMEs losing stock to outages (urgent need); deposit-before-order model limits exposure; pass exemption savings through once law

risk: Undercutting by informal online sellers and low-grade components
mitigation: Compete on certified installation, warranties and after-sales service, not on price; publish transparent package prices

risk: Installation defects and warranty claims from weak technical skills
mitigation: Certified lead technician; manufacturer training; commissioning checklist; 2% warranty provision in the model

risk: Stock-outs or counterfeit components from importers
mitigation: Two approved distributors per component; buy only registered products; inspect on delivery

risk: Cedi depreciation raises equipment cost between quote and purchase
mitigation: 7-day quote validity; 70% deposit triggers purchase; reprice weekly; sensitivity test shows impact

risk: Energy Commission licensing and standards enforcement; foreign partners risk 'trading' classification
mitigation: Licence before launch; keep certificates current; legal opinion before any foreign equity

risk: Electrical fire or injury during installation; theft of stock
mitigation: Insurance; PPE and isolation procedures; minimal stock held on site

risk: Customer acquisition slower than plan in the chosen neighbourhood
mitigation: Pre-launch WhatsApp waitlist; first-wash discounts; B2B contracts with hostels and guest houses

risk: Price competition from informal washers and well-funded entrants
mitigation: Position on turnaround reliability and garment care; subscriptions to lock in customers

risk: Garment damage or loss claims; staff reliability
mitigation: Tagging and photo intake; care-label training; 1% damage provision in the model

risk: Power and water interruptions raise generator fuel and water-tanker costs
mitigation: Generator and water storage in startup budget; schedule heavy loads at night; outage fuel line in opex

risk: Imported machine spare parts become expensive; utility tariff increases
mitigation: Buy brands with local service agents; keep a parts kitty in contingency

risk: Assembly permits and wastewater rules
mitigation: Obtain business operating permit before launch; use biodegradable detergents

risk: Machine breakdown, fire or theft of customer garments
mitigation: Preventive maintenance contract; insurance; secure storage

risk: Birds cannot be sold at market age; holding costs rise (reported for programme beneficiaries in 2026)
mitigation: Pre-sell batches to chop bars and caterers; dressed-bird option; schedule placements around festive peaks

risk: Frozen imports (about GHS 33/kg) and subsidised programme flocks cap prices
mitigation: Sell freshness and convenience (dressed, delivered); avoid commodity live-bird markets

risk: High mortality or poor feed conversion from husbandry gaps
mitigation: Experienced farm manager; vaccination schedule; brooding protocols; weekly weighing

risk: Feed price spikes (maize and soya)
mitigation: Buy maize at harvest and mix with concentrate; supplier contracts; reprice per batch

risk: Imported feed components (soya, premix) and chicks priced off FX
mitigation: Local maize base; monitor concentrate prices; batch-level pricing

risk: Veterinary, EPA and FDA requirements for farm and dressing
mitigation: Register with veterinary services; dress birds through a licensed facility if required

risk: Avian influenza outbreak forcing culling
mitigation: Biosecurity (foot dips, all-in/all-out, visitor control); single-age houses; disease reporting

risk: Seller volumes below plan
mitigation: Sign 10-15 anchor sellers before launch; monthly contracts with minimum volumes

risk: Platforms and informal riders undercut on price
mitigation: Compete on reliability, tracking and same-day COD settlement for sellers

risk: Rider churn; cash-on-delivery shortfalls or fraud
mitigation: Daily MoMo settlement; rider deposits and incentives; GPS tracking

risk: Fuel price increases (subsidy expected to end)
mitigation: Fuel surcharge clause in contracts; route batching

risk: Imported bikes and parts become expensive
mitigation: Standardise on one brand with local parts supply

risk: Commercial motorcycle rules still bedding in (union membership, rider licensing)
mitigation: Register riders with courier regulator and union from day one; monitor L.I. 2519 enforcement

risk: Road accidents and bike theft
mitigation: Defensive-riding training; helmets and PPE; insurance; trackers

risk: Micro and small firms will not pay monthly retainers
mitigation: Pilot with 5 paying clients before scaling; productised low-price entry packages

risk: Freelancers and do-it-yourself tools undercut prices
mitigation: Specialise by vertical (e.g., restaurants, pharmacies); sell measurable outcomes

risk: Key-person dependency; staff poached by clients
mitigation: Documented playbooks; non-solicitation clauses; profit-share

risk: Platform changes (algorithms, ad prices, WhatsApp Business fees)
mitigation: Diversify channels; bill ad spend at cost plus fee

risk: USD-priced software subscriptions; late client payments
mitigation: Prepaid monthly billing via MoMo; minimise USD tools

risk: Data-protection compliance when handling client customer data
mitigation: Register with the Data Protection Commission; simple data-processing agreements

risk: Laptop theft or account hacking
mitigation: Two-factor authentication; cloud backups; insurance
